title: Henry J. Steiner Lecturer in Human Rights
bio: Born October 14, 1969, in Cuernavaca, Morelos, México, Alfredo Gutiérrez Ortiz Mena is a Mexican jurist known for his transformative contributions to tax administration, human rights jurisprudence, and environmental justice. Education and Early Career He earned his LL.B. from UNAM and an LL.M. from Harvard University, where he also obtained a certificate in International Taxation […]
